rationale: Axium's current portfolio presents EdSan1A and EdSan1B together under Axium ES Holdings LLC. Direct FERC evidence establishes separate phase ownership and exact legal closes, supporting one manager-level PortCo, retirement of the standalone 1A duplicate, and removal of the unsupported AxInfra Fund I-IV heuristic. No later Axium exit or signed pending exit was identified.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count one Axium manager-level investment spanning operating ES1A and ES1B, while preserving separate phase SPVs, stakes and dates. Do not count either phase, its project entities or future non-Axium Edwards Sanborn phases separately.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: Keep production company cmrxpj7vt00ljivheoq991z94, rename it Edwards Sanborn Solar + Storage, and redirect/retire standalone 1A company cmrxpj7v900liivhelzpabyae. Supersede Task 116 only after release, application and production verification.

ownershipResolution.managerAliasDecision: Normalize Axium Managed Funds to Axium Infrastructure. Remove the AxInfra Fund I-IV link because no direct source identifies that curated fund. Preserve the disclosed AxInfra US LP and Axium ES Holdings vehicle chain.

currentInfrastructureManagerOwners.vehicle: Axium ES Holdings LLC / AxInfra US LP
currentInfrastructureManagerOwners.stake: Phase 1A: 80% Axium / 20% Terra-Gen. Phase 1B: Axium ES Holdings LLC acquired 50% while Terra-Gen retained 50%; AxInfra US LP owns 92.26% of Axium Co-Invest Holdings, the upstream co-invest holding company.
currentInfrastructureManagerOwners.announcementDate: Phase 1A completion announced 2022-10-26; Phase 1B transaction announced 2024-01-11

ownershipResolution.duplicateOwnerAction: Map the standalone 1A ownership period into the one canonical Axium period, retain the phase-specific ownership wording, and remove both generic AxInfra Fund I-IV links.

operatingResolution.description: Edwards Sanborn Solar + Storage is Axium's manager-level holding across the operating EdSan 1A and EdSan 1B utility-scale solar and battery-storage phases in Kern County, California. Axium's current portfolio reports 346 MW of solar and 1,339 MWh of storage for 1A and 358 MW of solar and 1,497 MWh of storage for 1B, while the transaction releases disclose 397 MWac / 1,505 MWh and 410 MWac / 1,497 MWh nameplate figures respectively. The projects serve utility, municipal-utility and corporate counterparties under long-term revenue contracts. Phase 1A closed with Axium at 80% and Terra-Gen at 20%; Phase 1B closed with Axium ES Holdings at 50% and Terra-Gen at 50%. The Axium-managed fund's economic share within the 1B acquisition vehicle is not stored as a combined-company percentage.
operatingResolution.productsAndServices: Utility-scale solar generation and grid-scale battery storage.
operatingResolution.customersAndEndMarkets: Utilities, municipal utilities and corporate offtakers under long-term contracts.
operatingResolution.footprint: Approximately 4,600 acres on land leased from Edwards Air Force Base and adjacent private land in Kern County, California, within CAISO.
disclosedScale: Transaction-era Phase 1A: 397 MWac solar and 1,505 MWh storage; 346 MWac at the point of interconnection
Transaction-era Phase 1B: 410 MWac solar and 1,497 MWh storage; 358 MWac at the point of interconnection
Combined transaction-era phases: 807 MWac solar and 3,002 MWh storage
Current Axium portfolio: 346 MW solar / 1,339 MWh storage for 1A and 358 MW solar / 1,497 MWh storage for 1B

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: FERC records show the Phase 1A transaction closed on 2022-10-20 and the Phase 1B transaction closed on 2023-12-22. Axium announced the completed 1A acquisition on 2022-10-26 and publicly announced the 1B investment on 2024-01-11.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatus: CLOSED_ACTIVE. Axium's live portfolio page still lists one Axium ES Holdings LLC holding covering EdSan1A and EdSan1B.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: Official Axium and Terra-Gen pages, FERC filings, and targeted sale, exit, secondary, recapitalization, restructuring and transfer searches through 2026-08-18 found no later Axium sale, signed pending exit or ownership transfer for either phase or the combined holding.

milestones.event: Axium ES Holdings completed its acquisition of 80% of the Phase 1A project companies from Terra-Gen; Terra-Gen retained 20%.
Axium ES Holdings completed the acquisition of 50% of the voting interests in the Phase 1B sellers; Terra-Gen retained the other 50%.
Axium publicly announced its Phase 1B investment and described Phases 1A and 1B as a combined 807 MWac solar and 3,002 MWh storage complex.
Axium's live portfolio continued to list Axium ES Holdings LLC as one current holding covering EdSan1A and EdSan1B.
